request.text: Create an accurate follow-up brief from the meeting notes and participant roster.

public_inputs.shape_summary: Complete notes with decisions, actions, and open questions
Complete participant roster available by artifact handle

requirements: Cover every confirmed decision and action item
Use only the supplied meeting evidence

nodes.task: Reconcile every decision, action item, owner, deadline, and unresolved question across the notes and roster.

inputs.purpose: Use the notes as authority for decisions, actions, and questions.
Verify participants and declared responsibilities.

output.semantic_description: A reconciled register of decisions, action items, ownership, deadlines, and unresolved questions.

acceptance_criteria: Every confirmed decision and action item appears exactly once.
Ownership and deadlines are grounded in the supplied materials.
Unresolved questions are separated from confirmed decisions.

nodes.task: Turn the reconciled meeting register into the requested follow-up brief with a clear action sequence and explicit unresolved items.

inputs.purpose: Use the reconciled register as the complete authority for the follow-up brief.

output.semantic_description: An accurate and actionable meeting follow-up brief.

acceptance_criteria: Every confirmed action is represented with its owner and deadline when declared.
All unresolved questions are visible.
The brief contains no unsupported decision or assignment.

request.text: Analyze the supplied feedback and produce a prioritized improvement brief using the declared categories and priority criteria.

public_inputs.shape_summary: Complete feedback table available by artifact handle
Complete definitions for the declared feedback categories

requirements: Apply the declared categories and priority criteria
Recommend improvements grounded in the findings

nodes.task: Extract every feedback issue and classify it using only the declared category definitions.

inputs.purpose: Inspect every supplied feedback entry.
Use the declared category definitions as the classification authority.

output.semantic_description: A complete category-aligned register of the supplied feedback issues.

acceptance_criteria: Every feedback entry is represented exactly once.
Every classification uses a declared category.
Source meaning is preserved without invented issues.

nodes.task: Assess the frequency, severity, and affected scope of each feedback theme in the classified evidence register.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete classified evidence as the basis for theme assessment.

output.semantic_description: A theme-level assessment of frequency, severity, and affected scope.

acceptance_criteria: Every declared theme traces to classified feedback entries.
Frequency and severity summaries are supported by the evidence register.

nodes.task: Evaluate the assessed feedback themes against the declared impact and urgency criteria and produce a justified priority order.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete theme assessment as evidence for prioritization.
Apply every declared impact and urgency criterion.

output.semantic_description: A criteria-grounded priority ordering of the assessed feedback themes.

acceptance_criteria: Every priority judgment cites the applicable declared criteria.
No theme is prioritized without evidence from the assessment.

nodes.task: Convert the prioritized findings into a concise improvement brief with justified recommendations.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete prioritized findings as the recommendation authority.

acceptance_criteria: Recommendations cover all high-priority findings.
Each recommendation is traceable to a prioritized theme.
The brief contains no unsupported improvement claim.

request.text: Compare two supplied proposals under one common set of criteria and deliver a justified recommendation brief.

public_inputs.shape_summary: Complete comparison criteria and decision requirements

requirements: Apply the same criteria to both proposals

capability_summary: Creates a consistent declared comparison basis

nodes.task: Convert every declared comparison criterion into a consistent assessment matrix without adding new criteria.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete criteria as the sole comparison authority.

output.semantic_description: A consistent and complete matrix of the declared comparison criteria.

acceptance_criteria: Every declared criterion is represented.
No undeclared criterion or weight is introduced.

nodes.task: Assess the first proposal against every item in the common criteria matrix.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete first proposal as assessment evidence.
Apply the common criteria consistently.

output.semantic_description: A criterion-by-criterion evidence assessment of the first proposal.

acceptance_criteria: Every criterion has an evidence-grounded assessment.
No evidence is attributed to the other proposal.

nodes.task: Assess the second proposal against every item in the common criteria matrix.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete second proposal as assessment evidence.
Apply the common criteria consistently.

output.semantic_description: A criterion-by-criterion evidence assessment of the second proposal.

acceptance_criteria: Every criterion has an evidence-grounded assessment.
No evidence is attributed to the other proposal.

nodes.task: Compare the two independent assessments criterion by criterion and distinguish evidence, advantages, limitations, and unresolved uncertainty.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete first-proposal assessment.
Use the complete second-proposal assessment.

output.semantic_description: A criterion-aligned comparison of both proposals with explicit uncertainty.

acceptance_criteria: Both assessments are compared under the same criteria.
Evidence is separated from comparative judgment.
Unresolved uncertainty remains explicit.

nodes.task: Produce the requested recommendation brief from the complete comparative findings.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete comparison as the recommendation basis.

output.semantic_description: A justified recommendation brief comparing the supplied proposals.

acceptance_criteria: The recommendation follows from the comparative findings.
Material tradeoffs and uncertainty are stated.
No unsupported proposal claim is introduced.

request.text: Assess the current project evidence and deliver a prioritized recovery plan with a concise status brief.

public_inputs.shape_summary: Complete schedule available by artifact handle
Complete issue log available by artifact handle
Complete budget summary available by artifact handle
Complete stakeholder constraints, commitments, and concerns

requirements: Integrate schedule, issue, budget, and stakeholder evidence
Distinguish current status from proposed action

nodes.task: Assess milestone completion, delay, sequence, and schedule dependency status from the complete project schedule.

inputs.purpose: Use every declared schedule and milestone record.

output.semantic_description: A milestone-level assessment of schedule status and schedule dependencies.

acceptance_criteria: Every declared milestone is represented.
Delay and dependency conclusions are grounded in the schedule.

nodes.task: Assess the state, impact, ownership, and dependencies of every item in the issue log.

inputs.purpose: Inspect every declared issue and dependency entry.

output.semantic_description: A complete assessment of open issues, impacts, ownership, and dependencies.

acceptance_criteria: Every issue is represented exactly once.
Impact and dependency findings trace to the issue log.

nodes.task: Compare planned and actual budget evidence and identify material variances and their declared scope.

inputs.purpose: Use every supplied planned and actual budget record.

output.semantic_description: An evidence-grounded assessment of material budget variances.

acceptance_criteria: Every material variance is calculated from supplied values.
No unexplained budget cause is invented.

nodes.task: Extract and reconcile declared stakeholder constraints, commitments, concerns, and unresolved conflicts.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete stakeholder feedback as the authority.

output.semantic_description: A reconciled register of stakeholder constraints, commitments, concerns, and conflicts.

acceptance_criteria: Every material stakeholder statement is represented.
Conflicts and uncertainty remain explicit.

nodes.task: Integrate schedule, issue, budget, and stakeholder assessments into one risk and dependency register without losing source distinctions.

inputs.purpose: Incorporate the complete schedule assessment.
Incorporate the complete issue and dependency assessment.
Incorporate the complete budget variance assessment.
Incorporate the complete stakeholder constraints register.

output.semantic_description: An integrated and source-traceable register of project risks and dependencies.

acceptance_criteria: All four assessment domains are represented.
Cross-domain dependencies are explicit.
Every risk remains traceable to its source assessment.

nodes.task: Develop a prioritized recovery plan that addresses the integrated risks, dependencies, and declared constraints.

inputs.purpose: Use the complete integrated risk register as the recovery-planning basis.

output.semantic_description: A prioritized recovery plan with risk coverage, ordering, and declared dependencies.

acceptance_criteria: Every high-priority risk has a corresponding action or explicit unresolved status.
Action ordering respects declared dependencies.
No undeclared authority or resource is assumed.

nodes.task: Produce the final brief by separating current evidence, risks, and proposed recovery actions.

inputs.purpose: Present the complete current risk and dependency status.
Present the prioritized recovery actions and their dependencies.

output.semantic_description: An evidence-grounded project status and recovery brief.

acceptance_criteria: Schedule, issue, budget, and stakeholder evidence are represented.
Current status is clearly separated from proposed action.
Recovery priorities and dependencies match the recovery plan.

request.text: The repair note names parse_record as the corrected function. Return only that function name, with no path or explanation.

nodes.task: Identify the function name stated in the request and return only that name.
acceptance_criteria: The answer is exactly one function name with no path or explanation.
